sources.title: BSRNN model checkpoints for music separation - Zenodo
sources.snippet: Here you can download the pretrained weights (PyTorch Lightning checkpoints) of the BSRNN model for music separation. These are unofficial, and correspond to our implementation, whose code is freely available here. These models are trained using the openly available MUSDB18-HQ dataset. sources.snippet: This repository is an unofficial implementation of the BSRNN model for music separation. It accompanies our replication study, whose primary goal is to obtain a model that yields similar results to those of the original BSRNN paper, and to explore reproducibility issues in music separation research.
